description: This file defines an ApiService class for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) to a backend server. It handles setting authentication tokens, constructing request headers, timeout management, and handling unauthorized responses. The class serves as an API client for a Flutter application interacting with a backend service.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A service class providing methods for making authenticated HTTP requests to a backend server, managing tokens, and handling unauthorized responses.

methods.name: ApiService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the base URL from environment variables or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets the authentication token to be used in request headers.

methods.name: _getHeaders
methods.description: Constructs request headers, including the Authorization header if a token is set and inclusion is requested.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified endpoint, with optional authentication requirement.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON-encoded body data to the specified endpoint, optional authentication.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON-encoded body data to the specified endpoint, optional authentication.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified endpoint, with optional authentication.

methods.name: _handleUnauthorized
methods.description: Handles 401 Unauthorized responses by clearing stored authentication data.
